description: ONDEWO Natural Language Understanding (NLU) Client library for Typescript

scripts.pretest: rm -rf .test-build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && ln -sfn ../api .test-build/api && npm run build:test:protos
scripts.test: c8 node --test .test-build/*/*.spec.js && npm run test:protos && npm run test:release
scripts.test:release: tsc tests/releaseNotes.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build && node --test .test-build/releaseNotes.spec.js
scripts.build:test:protos: tsc tests/bundleStringRoundTrip.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build
